description: One past VAT return as HMRC holds it, by its period key (the periodKey list_vat_obligations answers for a fulfilled obligation), over the deployed API. Use it to see what HMRC holds; to read Submit's stored copy of a return it filed, use get_vat_receipt. Uses the session's HMRC authorisation: call request_hmrc_authorisation first if this tool says none is held.

hmrcAccount.description: Which HMRC environment to call; defaults to the session's HMRC authorisation's own

periodKey.description: The obligation's period key, for example 18A1

name: get_vat_return
title: Get a submitted VAT return
